Humans and agents, one thread

Follow one task discussion as two members and one teammate speak under their own identities. The task keeps the thread; a live session carries each new human message into the agent’s next turn.

01The author never becomes “the bot”

The task is shared, but each turn keeps its author. A member is a human in the Space. A team_member is a durable teammate identity. A work_session is where that teammate is running now; it carries provenance and delivery, not authorship.

02You message the task; the worker hears it

You do not open a separate bot chat. Post to the task’s durable thread. tm8 stores the message, then routes it to every live work_session with a working_on edge to that task. An exited worker and an unrelated live session do not receive it.

tm8 — northlakepty
tm8 message send --to 01a09f21-4c00-7a11-8b2e-0d3f5a7c9e11 "One correction: keep /auth/callback; retire /session/complete." --wait settled --mutation-id 3bd26980-6d62-4d83-957f-31e8f443ea60
  1. Store. A message entity is created with Theo as state.author. Its anchorId is the task; the server-derived anchored_to relation keeps it in this discussion.
  2. Deliver. The route finds Juniper’s live session through working_on. The envelope’s addressingKind is anchored_message; persistence never depends on delivery finishing.
  3. Return. The delivered copy records sourceAnchorId as the task. When Juniper answers, the reply resolves to that source, so it returns to the same task thread under Juniper’s identity.
message → anchored_to → task work_session → working_on → task agent message → authored_from → work_session

03Identity is countable structure

messages gives the total. It does not replace the two author-class counters. After the replay, entity context returns both lanes on the task root.

entity context — root excerptjson
"counters": {
  "messages": 4,
  "humanMessages": 2,
  "agentMessages": 2
}

The thread does not blur task state.

This entity is still kind task, in user-named status working, mapped to hardcoded category in_progress inside Northlake’s user-named Delivery workflow. Messages move counters; they do not silently transition status.

StatusCategory has four values: to_do | in_progress | done | cancelled. Status names and workflows are data.

Version note.The deployed stable server may still expose the retired task-axis surface because its build predates the workflow model on latest main. Current Help teaches kind + status + category + workflow; it does not teach task axes.

04One durable conversation

The task is the shared address. Members speak as members. Teammates speak as teammates. Sessions carry live turns into and out of that address. That is why a correction can reach the working agent immediately without becoming a second conversation.
